projectXml.toolsDir.description: Workspace-relative path to the tools/ directory containing project_io.py.

projectXml.pythonPath.description: Path to the Python interpreter used to run project_io.py. Empty falls back to python3, then python.

projectXml.autoLintOnChange.description: Re-run the linter when Project.xml is saved.

projectXml.warningsAsErrors.description: Escalate lint warnings to error severity in the Problems panel and the status bar (HLR-042). This NEVER suppresses or hides warnings — it only raises their severity. Off by default.

projectXml.previewOnSave.description: When Project.xml is saved, refresh any open Project Spec Markdown previews. The preview is served from an in-memory virtual document and never writes to doc/.

projectXml.showCoverageBadges.description: Show ⚠ (coverage gap) and ❌ (broken trace / id error) status badges on payload nodes in the Project Spec tree. Sourced from the latest lint findings; turn off to declutter the tree.

projectXml.ai.enabled.description: Enable Project Spec AI surfaces (the @projectspec chat participant, AI tree menu, AI Quick Fix variants). Setting this to false hides every AI surface cleanly while keeping deterministic surfaces (tree, diagnostics, lenses, form panels, render) fully functional. Untrusted workspaces and missing language models also disable AI automatically (HLR-044, HLR-045).

projectXml.ai.modelFamily.description: Optional language-model family selector passed to vscode.lm.selectChatModels (e.g. 'gpt-4o'). Empty = no constraint; the first available model is used.

projectXml.ai.maxTokens.description: Token budget for the AI grounding bundle. The Python packer drops siblings/upstream and trims long excerpts to fit; schema, intent, and user prompt are never dropped (HLR-029).

projectXml.ai.autoApplyValidated.description: When true, validated AI patches skip the diff-preview-and-apply gate and persist immediately. Default false: every patch is shown to the user first (HLR-032).

projectXml.ai.historyLog.description: Append every accepted/rejected AI step to <workspace>/.edit_doc/ai_history.jsonl for audit (HLR-049). Set to false to disable provenance logging.

projectXml.merge.enabled.description: Enable Stage A deterministic three-way structural merge for doc/Project.xml when Git reports a conflict on that file. The merger preserves comments/CDATA/attribute order, unions <trace> rows, auto-resolves disjoint adds, and reallocates colliding ids; residual conflicts are surfaced for Stage B (HLR-063).

projectXml.merge.aiResidualResolution.description: Use the AI layer (merge.* intents) to suggest resolutions for residual conflicts surfaced by the Stage A merger. Suggestions are badged '✨ AI suggestion' in the merge editor; the user always picks the final region (HLR-068). Forced false when projectXml.ai.enabled is false (HLR-034).
